# Alpha 46 — Folder Hub and mobile workspace polish

- Rename the mobile Files destination to Folder Hub, with a collection icon and grouped-folder Home shortcut. Select a folder for Pull/Push actions, then Browse Local, LocalCrypt or Remote to enter its file browser.
- Preserve complete native simulator test reports in a fresh, atomic cache file, retaining full test/source validation when Apple’s log stream loses the final result.
- Validate native destination labels independently from persistent routing keys. This supersedes the unpublished alpha 44 and 45 candidates.
- Align browser return links, settings and user guidance with Folder Hub naming.
- Improve mobile light/dark colours, chat presentation and streaming controls, and retain the next unsent chat draft.
- Restore workspace menu controls on first tab selection and native Back navigation; improve retained drawers and native pane verification.

Local validation passed 175 mobile UI/tooling tests and 51 mobile core tests (three native-bridge cases skipped), lint checks, a signed physical iPhone build with identity verification, and full local iPhone and iPad native UI suites including screen review and independent iPad windows. Release publication requires the desktop platform checks and native Android/iOS build/runtime gates. TestFlight distribution uses a separately signed iOS archive; physical touch, accessibility and Duo fold gestures require device validation.
